summary: Crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against yield loss from natural calamities, pests and disease.
benefits: Insurance cover and claim payout for crop loss; low uniform premium share for farmers, balance subsidized by government.
eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
Both loanee and non-loanee farmers eligible
application_steps: Apply through bank (if loanee) or online/CSC (if non-loanee) before the cut-off date each season
